name: Alexander Key
label: Senior Developer
summary: Senior Ruby on Rails developer with 10 years shipping and operating production Rails applications end to end, from architecture, Stripe payments, and Hotwire front ends to PostgreSQL and the Linux servers and CI/CD pipelines behind them. Led small teams through three ground-up rebuilds of legacy platforms onto modern Rails, most recently a Rails 3 to Rails 8 rewrite.

bullets: Modernized a legacy Rails 3 restaurant reservation platform by leading a small team through a ground-up rewrite to Rails 8, architecting the new application and building its production infrastructure from scratch with Dokku server provisioning and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

Expanded the platform into a new vertical, tour and boat charter operators, by designing and building an end-to-end private charter product: embeddable lead-capture widget, prioritized booking pipeline, quote/deposit/balance invoicing with Stripe, digital waivers, and crew assignment with automated itineraries.

Enabled clients to track Google and Meta ad conversions across the entire booking funnel by white-labeling reservations onto client-owned subdomains, building the multi-tenant routing and automated per-client DNS/SSL provisioning behind it.

Replaced a failing legacy .NET platform for Greek house meal management by leading a small team through a ground-up Ruby on Rails rebuild, owning architecture, servers, and CI/CD from first commit to a launch serving chapters across multiple universities.

Shipped iOS and Android apps from a single Rails codebase using Hotwire Native, letting members reserve meals and late plates against chef-published menus with per-member allergy and dietary tracking, meal-plan limits and billing compliance, and printable kitchen prep lists.

Carried every client's historical data through the replatform by converting the legacy MSSQL database to PostgreSQL, reverse-engineering the old schema and migrating chapters, members, meal plans, and reservation history into the new Rails domain model.

Built and scaled a Rails restaurant management platform to 100+ restaurants and $250K+ in annual revenue by leading a small team of developers from architecture through launch, owning the full stack from application code and PostgreSQL schema design to production servers and deployment.

Processed 8 figures in payment volume by architecting the online ordering system end to end: Stripe checkout and refunds, Uber Direct delivery integration, order scheduling, and a full catering system.

Delivered the platform's most complex feature, live table management, by building real-time table-state synchronization across every device in the restaurant with ActionCable WebSockets, giving front-of-house staff a single live view of the floor.
Modernized a city guide platform running on a decade-old .NET codebase by rebuilding it from the ground up in Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL as sole developer.
Achieved #1 Google rankings for multiple competitive local keywords by pairing the rebuild with aggressive on-page SEO: content structure, technical optimization, and page-speed work.

Increased click-through rates on the site's highest-traffic pages by building in-house analytics and an A/B split-testing framework in Rails, measuring real user behavior and then iterating page layouts against live traffic.

skills.items: Ruby, Ruby on Rails (3 – 8), Active Record, Active Job, ActionCable, Action Mailer, Active Merchant, Stripe, RSpec, Sidekiq, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, Twilio, Postmark, Uber Direct
Hotwire (Turbo & Stimulus), Hotwire Native (iOS & Android), JavaScript, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap
Linux, Kamal, Dokku, Nginx, GitHub Actions
